import pytest
import warnings

# In pytest 8.4.2, PytestRemovedIn9Warning could be issued as a warning
# and the code would continue. This test verifies the old behavior where
# deprecated features would warn but not fail by default.

def test_deprecated_feature():
    # Using a deprecated API that raises PytestRemovedIn9Warning
    # In 8.4.2 this would warn but pass
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        # The deprecated monkeypatch.syspath_prepend with namespace packages
        # would issue a warning in 8.4.2
        pass
    # Test passes in 8.4.2 without errors
title: PytestRemovedIn9Warning now raises errors by default instead of warnings
